heat35_jul_aug.label: Very hot days (Tmax ≥ 35 °C), Jul–Aug
heat35_jul_aug.why: Maize flowering/grain fill: heat + drought raise pollination failure and aflatoxin risk.

heat32_jul_aug.label: Hot days (Tmax ≥ 32 °C), Jul–Aug
heat32_jul_aug.why: Heat stress for summer crops (maize, sunflower) during flowering and grain fill.

heat30_jun.label: Hot days (Tmax ≥ 30 °C), June
heat30_jun.why: Heat at flowering of spring pulses, oats and flax (pea pod set drops above ~30 °C).

late_frost.label: Late frost days (Tmin < 0 °C), 15 Apr–31 May
late_frost.why: Frost after spring sowing damages emerging spring crops (sunflower, maize, chickpea, flax).

rain_flowering_small_grain.label: Rain, 15 May–30 Jun
rain_flowering_small_grain.why: Wet weather at small-grain flowering (wheat, barley, oats) raises Fusarium / mycotoxin risk.

wet_days_flowering_small_grain.label: Wet days (≥ 1 mm), 15 May–30 Jun
wet_days_flowering_small_grain.why: Frequent rain days during flowering favour Fusarium infection.

rh_flowering_small_grain.label: Mean relative humidity, 15 May–30 Jun
rh_flowering_small_grain.why: High humidity during flowering favours Fusarium infection.

rain_harvest_small_grain.label: Rain in July (small-grain harvest)
rain_harvest_small_grain.why: Rain at harvest causes sprouting, quality loss and harvest delays.

rain_harvest_summer_crops.label: Rain, Sep–Oct (maize/sunflower harvest)
rain_harvest_summer_crops.why: Wet harvests raise drying costs and mould / mycotoxin risk.

dry_spell_apr_sep.label: Longest dry spell (< 1 mm/day), Apr–Sep
dry_spell_apr_sep.why: Long dry spells cause drought stress, worst when they hit flowering.

gdd10_apr_sep.label: Growing degree days (base 10 °C), Apr–Sep
gdd10_apr_sep.why: Heat units available for warm-season crops like maize and sunflower.

et_apr_sep.label: Evapotranspiration, Apr–Sep
et_apr_sep.why: Water used by vegetation and soil.

water_balance_apr_sep.label: Water balance (rain − ET), Apr–Sep
water_balance_apr_sep.why: Negative = vegetation used more water than fell as rain (drawing down soil water).

rootmoist_jja.label: Root-zone soil moisture, Jun–Aug mean
rootmoist_jja.why: Water in the root zone during the critical summer months.

rootmoist_jja_z.label: Root-zone soil moisture anomaly, Jun–Aug
rootmoist_jja_z.why: Compared with 2015–2025 (unit mean / std): below −1 = clearly drier summer than usual.

confidence.note: From regional grids (POWER ~50 km, GLDAS ~25 km). Day counts are area-weighted averages, so they can be fractional. 2026: POWER windows only where 2026 data exist (cells around Alba Iulia); GLDAS ends 2026-07, so 2026 water-balance and summer soil-moisture values are empty.
